scripts.test:receipt: set -o pipefail; bun test 2>&1 | tee artifacts/test-receipt.log; status=$?; bun -e "const fs=require('fs');const log=fs.readFileSync('artifacts/test-receipt.log','utf8');const m=log.match(/(\d+) pass\s*(\d+) fail[\s\S]*?Ran (\d+) tests across (\d+) files\. \[([\d.]+)s\]/);if(!m){console.error('test:receipt: could not parse test summary');process.exit(1)}fs.writeFileSync('artifacts/test-receipt.json',JSON.stringify({tests:+m[3],pass:+m[1],fail:+m[2],files:+m[4],durationMs:Math.round(+m[5]*1000),commit:process.env.GITHUB_SHA||require('child_process').execSync('git rev-parse HEAD').toString().trim()}))"; rc=$?; if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then exit $rc; fi; exit $status
